scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter @workspace/engine --filter @workspace/shared --filter @workspace/security --if-present run typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint artifacts/party-game artifacts/api-server/src lib/engine lib/shared lib/security lib/db/src tests e2e *.ts *.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check docs tests e2e artifacts/party-game/src artifacts/api-server/src lib/engine lib/shared lib/security
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:property && npm run test:integration && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:accessibility && npm run audit
